title: Phishing Through University SSO
scenario: A page copies your university login screen but the URL is not the university domain.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Phishing Through University SSO: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: SSO pages must match official domains exactly.
